objective: Wire the Pi tool surface of the HolyAgent Pi integration from existing Pi tools and extensions, as data and functions the launcher and setup will use, in /home/user/holyagent-0.3.0-tools (branch release/0.3.0/feat/pi-tools).
scope: Work only in /home/user/holyagent-0.3.0-tools; node_modules is installed. Gates: bunx --no-install mise run verify and bunx --no-install mise run build.

Binding requirements: /home/user/holyagent-notes/intent-tool-surface.txt (the Intent; read every requirement and Decided entry). Also read AGENTS.md, .claude/CLAUDE.md, docs/pi/extensions.md, docs/pi/configuration.md, docs/pi/claude-parity.md, docs/pi/orchestration.md, docs/pi/caching-and-subagents.md, packages/runtime/src/config/{schema,packages,pi-packages}.ts and pi-packages.json, packages/runtime/src/pi/{provider,index}.ts, and the pi probes /home/user/holyagent-notes/pi-deps.md and /home/user/holyagent-notes/pi-probe/ (READMEs of pi-coding-agent, pi-web-kit, pi-processes, billion-context, rpiv-todo, rpiv-ask-user-question). Do not run the pi binary.

Build: (1) one module (for example packages/runtime/src/pi/tools.ts) that gives, per route-table role and for the root, the Pi --tools / --exclude-tools arguments from the route table's allowlists as the requirements state them (read-only roles: read, grep, find, ls; Worker.operations and Worker.validation: bash without write or edit; Reviewer.code keeps bash; Librarian roles get the web tools; codemode for the root via +codemode), so no other place decides a role's tools; (2) the web-tool choice: when the provider's extension offers web tools (Kimi: moonshot_search, moonshot_fetch) pi-web-kit is not loaded, otherwise pi-web-kit is, as config.json selects; (3) the config.json switches for each tool or feature and the package that carries it (todo, ask, processes, web, billion-context, MCP, computer use where present), so a disabled one is neither loaded nor required, reusing packages.ts and the pi-packages table; (4) the Billion Context settings the requirements decide (delegate.forceEnable for root and specialists, its own subagents off) as data for setup to write, plus anything else the Decided entries specify; (5) docs/pi/extensions.md and docs/pi/configuration.md updated to the code, including what MCP and T3 tools need from the user and that their absence makes the visual roles report the inspection as blocked.
Out of scope: launching processes, writing Pi settings files (setup), the T3 integration, the system prompt. Name what they need in the report.
constraints: Unit tests with synthesized fixtures only; no pi binary, no live model, no network.
Reuse existing carriers; add custom code only where the requirements say no existing carrier exists, and say which.
Dependencies and pins change only through the updater's table; do not hand-edit bun.lock or ranges.
Keep the Claude generated output unchanged.
Make no version-control writes and no edits under .git/ or .holyagent/; report changed paths.
Follow .claude/CLAUDE.md (Effect, Schema with onExcessProperty error, JSDoc on exports, Bun APIs).
Report in under 450 words; start each evidence line with the exact criterion text (no backticks), a colon, then the support; put long logs in a file outside the repository.

criteria.text: One module gives every role's and the root's Pi tool arguments as the requirements state, with tests per role
pi-web-kit is loaded only when the provider extension offers no web tools, as config.json selects, with tests
Each tool or feature switch in config.json enables or disables its carrier package, and a disabled one is neither loaded nor required, with tests
The Billion Context and other decided settings are provided as data with tests
docs/pi/extensions.md and docs/pi/configuration.md match the code
Only the tool-surface scope is built; launcher, setup and T3 needs are named, not built
bunx --no-install mise run verify exits 0 and mise run build leaves generated output in sync
